# VRInput

> **Kind:** context · **Registry:** host · **Folder:** [`src/logic/components/`](../folders/src-logic-components.md)
> **Source:** [`src/logic/components/vr.h`](../../../src/logic/components/vr.h)

## Summary

Head and controller poses and buttons, in stage space, written each frame by the VR renderer.

## Description

Host context variable emplaced by VRActions (src/renderer/vr_render/vr_input.cpp; also registered when VR is disabled) and written after xrWaitFrame. Holds the head VRPose and two Hand entries (index VRInput::left = 0, VRInput::right = 1) with pose, linear velocity (stage space, m/s), trigger/grip values, thumbstick and rising-edge flags. Read by VRControlSys, RollerPlayer, DebugMenu, VRRender, ChunkManagerSys (session_running).

| `hands[2].primary` | `bool` | false | A (right) / X (left) on Touch, A on Index |
| `hands[2].primary_pressed` | `bool` | false | rising edge this frame |

## Side effects per system

- **[VRActions](../systems/VRActions.md)**
  - creates the OpenXR action set, 5 actions, suggested bindings for Touch/Index/simple controllers, hand and view spaces
  - xrSyncActions, xrGetActionState*, xrLocateSpace
- **[VRRender](../systems/VRRender.md)**
  - xrPollEvent, xrBeginSession/xrEndSession on READY/STOPPING
  - xrWaitFrame (blocks to the headset cadence), xrBeginFrame
  - logging of session state changes
